title: O$^2$PD: Overlap-Gated On-Policy Distillation on Reliable Prefix
abstract: arXiv:2611.07731v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) supplies dense token-level supervision by aligning a student to the teacher's next-token distribution on its own generated rollouts. Existing works mostly implement top-$k$ OPD, applying reverse Kullback-Leibler ($\RKL$) divergence between the teacher's and the student's renormalized distributions over teacher top-$k$ support. However, the teacher scores student-generated rollouts that are inherently off-policy for itself, leaving the reliability of its next-token guidance unclear. Restricting the divergence to the teacher top-$k$ support also discards the remaining mass outside that support. These gaps leave two questions implicit: 1) which tokens to align, and 2) how to align those tokens. To answer these questions, we propose Overlap-gated On-Policy Distillation (O$^{2}$PD). translated_title: O$^2$PD：基于可靠前缀的重叠门控在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生自身生成的 rollout 上将学生对齐到教师的下一 token 分布，从而提供密集的 token 级监督。现有工作大多实现 top-$k$ OPD，即在教师 top-$k$ 支持集上，对教师与学生的重归一化分布应用反向 Kullback-Leibler（RKL）散度。然而，教师所打分的学生生成的 rollout 对教师自身而言天然是离策略的，其下一 token 引导的可靠性并不明确。将散度限制在教师 top-$k$ 支持集上，也会丢弃该支持集之外的概率质量。这些缺陷隐含了两个问题：1）对齐哪些 token；2）如何对齐这些 token。为回答这些问题，我们提出重叠门控在线策略蒸馏（O$^2$PD）。针对问题 1），我们定量分析了教师监督的可靠性，并发现对学生轨迹上的 token 进行对齐……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出 O$^2$PD 方法，通过定量分析教师监督的可靠性来确定“对齐哪些 token”（可靠前缀），并以重叠门控机制决定“如何对齐”，从而弥补现有 top-$k$ 在线策略蒸馏在监督可靠性与概率质量丢弃方面的不足。
en_tdlr: Proposes O$^2$PD, an overlap-gated on-policy distillation method that quantitatively assesses the reliability of teacher supervision to decide which tokens to align (reliable prefix) and how to align them, addressing reliability and mass-discarding gaps in top-$k$ on-policy distillation.
